channel.title: DecentraWise
channel.description: Building blockchains, smart contracts, dapps and changing the world as we know it...

item.title: Cryptography 101: Cryptographic Basis for Blockchain and Web3 Developers
item.description: In this episode we discuss the basics of cryptography required for blockchain and web3 developers.

item.title: Token Standards: Deep Dive on ERC20, ERC721 and ERC1155 Token Standards and their use cases
item.description: In this episode we discuss Token Standards. A Deep Dive on ERC20, ERC721 and ERC1155 Token Standards and some ideas for their use cases.

item.title: Blockchain Organizations (BORGs): What they are and why they matter? Comparison with DAOs
item.description: In this episode we discuss Blockchain Organizations (BORGs) and compare them with DAOs. Also we go through some case studies of applications of BORGs and why they differ in governance.

item.title: YOUR OWN Token Airdrop: Learn, Build and Deploy it with us in a live coding session
item.description: In this episode we'll build a token airdrop contract from scratch, using Open Zeppelin tools and Remix IDE, and deploy it on a local network and to Sepolia testnet, and test it on Metamask. After this episode you'll be able to do it all on your own!

item.title: NFTs and IPFS Decentralized Storage: Why that REALLY Matters? Launch your NFTs the RIGHT WAY...
item.description: In this episode we'll change the NFT Collection from last episode to use IPFS Decentralized Storage, using Open Zeppelin tools and Remix IDE, and deploy it on a local network and to Sepolia testnet, and show it on OpenSea for selling. After this episode you'll be able to do it all on your own!

item.title: Launch YOUR NFT Collection: Build and Deploy it with us in a live coding session
item.description: In this episode we'll build an NFT Collection from scratch, using Open Zeppelin tools and Remix IDE, and deploy it on a local network and to Sepolia testnet, and show it on OpenSea for selling. After this episode you'll be able to do it all on your own!

item.title: Launch YOUR Meme Coin: Build and Deploy it with us in a live coding session!
item.description: In this episode we'll build a Meme Coin from scratch, using Open Zeppelin tools and Remix IDE, and deploy it on a local network and to Sepolia testnet. After this episode you'll be able to do it all on your own!

item.title: Web3 Primer: Come Build Your Own First NOT SO SMART Contracts with us and Have a Blast!
item.description: In this episode we make an introduction to smart contract development and live code some REALLY NOT that smart contracts along with you, deploy them and interact with them, so that you learn how to build on your own.

item.title: Zero Knowledge 101: Understanding Proofs, SNARKs, Rollups, and Beyond
item.description: In this episode we discuss all things Zero Knowledge, from Zero Knowledge Proofs and SNARKs to Rollups... You'll get them all in just an episode!

item.title: Contributing to Open Source Blockchain Projects: SHOULD IT BE Your Next Career Move?
item.description: In this episode we discuss the Power of Open Source and Contributing to Blockchain Projects. We highlight the benefits of contributing to open-source blockchain projects, and how to find them and start, discussing how participation can enhance your skills, expand your network, and open doors to exciting career opportunities.

item.title: The Truth About Decentralized Identity: Addressing Its Critical Issues!
item.description: In this episode we discuss The Truth About Decentralized Identity and address its Critical Issues.

item.title: Crypto Privacy and Anonymity: Importance of Anonymity and Privacy in Public Networks!
item.description: In this episode we discuss privacy and anonymity on blockchain networks, and why it is an important thing.

item.title: Mastering the Art of Hackathons: Tips, Tricks & Tactics for Web3 and Blockchain Developers
item.description: In this episode we discuss the importance of Hackathons, and what they might bring to the table for an aspiring Web3 Developer. We also add tips, tricks & tactics from our own experience in many Hackathons and from winning some prizes as well.

item.title: Breaking Chains: How Centralization of On/Off Ramps Threatens Crypto Freedom!
item.description: In this episode we discuss about how Centralization of On/Off Ramps Threatens Crypto Freedom. New implications of prohibitions of peer to peer transactions in Europe and other attempts to control our digital life.

item.title: Scaling for Success: A Deep Dive into Ethereum's Scalability Solutions!
item.description: In this episode we discuss Scalability Solutions for Ethereum: Explore various scalability solutions for blockchain networks, such as layer 2 solutions, and their potential impact on transaction throughput and cost. A deep dive into the impact of Ethereum PoS scalability and Ethereum L2's: ZK Rollups, Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum...

item.title: Scaling for Success: A Deep Dive into Bitcoin's Scalability Solutions!
item.description: In this episode we discuss Scalability Solutions for Blockchain: Explore various scalability solutions for blockchain networks, such as layer 2 solutions, and their potential impact on transaction throughput and cost. A deep dive into Lightning Network, Liquid Network, Fedimint, Stacks and Rootstock RSK.

item.title: Centralization in Web3 Decentralized Projects: Navigating the Grey Area!
item.description: In this episode we discuss the fine line between a centralized and decentralized web3 project, so we explore some of the centralization aspects of many web3 projects and the reasons why they are important.

item.title: Becoming a CORE Blockchain Developer in 2024: The pros and cons as a career option!
item.description: In this episode we discuss about how to become a Core Blockchain Developer in 2024: The pros and cons as a career option!

item.title: Becoming a Web3 and Smart Contracts Security Auditor in 2024: The pros and cons as a career option!
item.description: In this episode we discuss about becoming a Web3 and Smart Contracts Security Auditor in 2024: The pros and cons as a career option!

item.title: From Zero to Hero: Web3 Developer in 2024 – Your Ultimate Guide!
item.description: In this episode we discuss Some ideas about how to become a web3 developer in 2024.

item.title: Building the Future: Exploring Web3 Development Tools and Frameworks
item.description: In this episode we discuss Web3 Development Tools. Highlight the tools and frameworks available for developers working on Web3 projects, including blockchain development platforms, wallets, and testing frameworks.

item.title: Blockchain: A Closer Look at Privacy and Security Measures #2 🌐🔒
item.description: In this episode we continue the discussion of Privacy and Security in Blockchain: Explore privacy-focused blockchain technologies and discuss the importance of security in decentralized systems.

item.title: Blockchain: A Closer Look at Privacy and Security Measures 🌐🔒
item.description: In this episode we discuss Privacy and Security in Blockchain: Explore privacy-focused blockchain technologies and discuss the importance of security in decentralized systems.

item.title: How to Build a DAO in 2024: Problems to face and how to build a productive and inclusive DAO
item.description: In this episode we discuss the challenges behind building a DAO, from our own experience by participating in some DAOs.

item.title: Crypto Compass: Navigating the Future Regulatory Landscape of Crypto and Blockchain!
item.description: In this episode we discuss the regulatory Landscape for Blockchain and Cryptocurrencies: Discuss the current regulatory environment for blockchain and cryptocurrencies globally, and how it might evolve in the future.

item.title: Empowering Communities: Navigating Governance Models in Decentralized Networks
item.description: In this episode we discuss Governance Models in Decentralized Systems, and we examine different governance models in decentralized networks, including DAOs (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations), and discuss their implications for decision-making and community involvement.

item.title: 2024 Unwrapped: Web3 & Blockchain Development + Security Projections!
item.description: In this episode we chat about the projections for web3 and blockchain development and security aspects of the new year 2024.

item.title: Year-End Web3 & Blockchain Development Review 2023 | Security Insights Included!
item.description: In this episode we review the web3 and blockchain development and security aspects of the year 2023.

item.title: Blockchain Economics 101: Navigating Economic Models, Incentive Structures and Sustainability
item.description: In this episode we discuss Tokenomics and Economic Models in Blockchain Projects - Delve into the economic models behind blockchain projects, tokenomics, and how they influence user incentives, project sustainability, and community engagement.

item.title: Embrace the Future: Web3 and the Transformation of the Internet! 💻🚀
item.description: In this episode we discuss Web3 and the Evolution of the Internet: Explore the concept of Web3 and how it represents the next phase in the evolution of the internet, emphasizing decentralization, user control, and privacy.

item.title: The Ultimate Guide to Smart Contracts: How They're Reshaping Business and Beyond!
item.description: In this episode we discuss Smart Contracts and Their Applications: Explore the concept of smart contracts, their role in blockchain technology, and how they are being used across different industries for automation and trustless execution.

item.title: Breaking Barriers: Navigating the DeFi Landscape and Transforming Finance
item.description: In this episode we discuss DeFi (Decentralized Finance) Platforms and Applications: Dive into the world of decentralized finance, discussing various DeFi platforms, lending protocols, and the potential disruption of traditional financial systems.

item.title: Beyond Overpriced JPEGs: NFTs and the Next Chapter in Digital Ownership
item.description: In this episode we discuss NFTs and the Future of Digital Ownership: Explore the impact of Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) on various industries and discuss how they are changing the concept of digital ownership.

item.title: MEV Ethical "Cleanex" & THE UNFAIR ADVANTAGE for Web3 Developers
item.description: In this episode we clear some Ethical doubts about MEV and explore it with a Developer view. Developers have a clear unfair advantage in this scenario and we want to address what can and can't be done to increase our passive profits.

item.title: Web3 SUPERPOWERS for Humanity: Building Stronger Values and Tools
item.description: In this episode we discuss Core Values in the Web3 Developer Community. Coming from Bitcoin's Scarcity and Libertarian views to Web3's Abundance, Collaborative and Community Driven and often Governance based systems.

item.title: From BITCOIN's Scarcity to WEB3's Abundance: A VALUES Debate
item.description: In this episode we discuss Core Values in the Web3 Developer Community. Coming from Bitcoin's Scarcity and Libertarian views to Web3's Abundance, Collaborative and Community Driven and often Governance based systems.
